title: Depth depends on referenced values
statement: Let $g$ be a Boolean circuit gate and let $ds,ds'$ be lists of natural numbers. If the values looked up in these lists at every argument of $g$ agree, using $0$ when an index is out of range, then the depth of $g$ computed from $ds$ equals its depth computed from $ds'$.
hypotheses_covered: $ds$ and $ds'$ are lists of natural numbers
For every argument $a$ of $g$, the defaulted lookups in $ds$ and $ds'$ at index $a$ are equal
